# JANE ROE
~	1986 born in Westfield | ZZ
+	Lives and works in Eastmoor | YY
# ABOUT
~	Jane Roe is a painter and textile artist. She works with tides, weather and woven structures, and with the slow, repeated gestures that both painting and weaving ask for.
